children: Sphere Entertainment adopted an overlap policy extending conflict-of-interest provisions to directors and officers serving MSG Rangers.
Following MSG Rangers’ distribution to MSG Knickerbockers stockholders, Sphere Entertainment disclosed overlapping officers and directors across the companies.
Overlapping roles and ownership interests may create conflicts involving corporate opportunities, commercial arrangements or company decisions.
Sphere Entertainment’s articles address certain corporate opportunities and validate specified transactions with MSG-related entities.
The board’s new policy extends those provisions to Sphere Entertainment personnel serving MSG Rangers or its subsidiaries.
